title: Apps-based Operators or Operators Offering Courier Services Using Private-hire Vehicles and Taxis
what_it_is: Apps-based Operators or Operators Offering Courier Services Using Private-hire Vehicles and Taxis

sections.label: Courier services by taxis and PHCs
sections.summary: MP asks about app-based courier services using taxis and private hire vehicles, LTA insurance checks, and review of regulations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) whether the Ministry is aware of apps-based operators or operators offering courier services using private hire vehicles and taxis; (b) whether LTA checks that such vehicles come with relevant commercial accident insurance; and (c) what is the progress on the National Taxi Association and National Private Hire Vehicles Association's calls for reviewing of regulations that allow their vehicles to do courier services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This is to ensure that taxis and PHCs remain available to provide point-to-point (P2P) services for commuters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Drivers found violating these rules may have their vocational licences revoked.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Thus far, LTA has not found any driver in violation of these rules.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Taxi and PHC operators that are interested in allowing their drivers to perform courier services on a limited trial basis may approach LTA to discuss such a possibility.
